hotel_name: Red Fox By Lemon Tree Hotels, East Delhi

positive_snippets: We had a wonderful time at Red Fox (Mayur Vihar) with my family. The rooms were neat and clean; the services were flawless. The staff was very nice and professional. The location is also very convenient for us, and it's easy to park our car right in front of the spacious compound. The food menus were not so rich for a large family who would go for different options. But for our family there were sufficient options to choose from. The prices were very reasonable; I really like it and would definitely visit again.

Rooms are too small. I believe single and double rooms are same except for the bed. Very congested space. But one thing to appreciate a lot of the management is that they help people who have some disabilities to work there. Secondly, the toiletries are so limited
Very cordial and well behaved staff members. Our stay with red fox was very pleasant.
negative_snippets:
We had a really bad experience at this hotel. First things first, the Wifi was bad. They had free wifi but that wifi was not meant for streaming. Just for mails. For actual wifi, they wanted us to pay extra. For this reason, we could not even use the big TV in the room since there is no internet.
The bathroom stinks really bad. There is some issue with the drainage system. It stinks bad before even using. The AC was not working. It only gave out air. Not cool air, just air. We were sweating at night. Overall really bad experience. Will not recommend to anyone:
